Founder. Veteran. Financial educator.

A disciplined approach with a deeply personal purpose.

Kerissa Rivas founded KeriBloom Legacy Group to give people a place where serious financial decisions can be discussed clearly, honestly and without unnecessary pressure.

Her path

Service shaped the standard.

Kerissa’s professional approach was shaped by environments where preparation, accountability and trust were not optional. Military service strengthened her discipline. Financial experience showed her how often families make major decisions without enough explanation. Leadership taught her that people respond best when they feel heard.

KeriBloom was built around those lessons. The firm is designed to combine professional structure with personal attention, giving clients time to understand the issue before selecting a direction.
